state: **Side goal `one-temp-root`, stage 2: `nvs_repo::socket` exists, and no site uses it yet.** It returns a `Scratch` guard for `target/test-scratch/sock-<pid>-<n>/` and the absolute socket path inside it, built from `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`'s ancestors so the path holds no `..` (the private `repository()` still joins `../..`, which `socket` avoids because those bytes count against the limit). On Unix it stops when the path passes 107 bytes (Linux) or 103 (macOS, BSD). The message says to move the checkout to a shorter path, not to set `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` as the goal's prose suggested: scratch always sits under `<repo>/target/`, so that variable would not help. On Windows nothing is checked, because the socket sites there use pipe names. `NOT_YET_MOVED` in `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs` is unchanged. Stage 3, the two runners, has not started.
